input_messages.content: Hey, I just had a sync with Wanghao to prep for the OKR review. He showed up in his favorite blue hoodie, looking a bit exhausted. He actually mentioned he was feeling a bit tired of the whole OKR review process honestly.
Hey! I don't blame him, OKR season is always a grind. Did you guys manage to get the data you needed for the review?
Yeah, we did. We got a bit sidetracked at first and debated whether the OKR review template looked better in dark mode, but we eventually got to the actual metrics.
Dark mode is always the right answer for devs! What did you figure out for the numbers? Remember Boss Zhang wants the classroom refactoring done by the end of Q3, so the metrics need to be solid.
Exactly. To justify the Q3 timeline, Wanghao concluded for the OKR review that the new video rendering engine will reduce latency by 45%.
That's a massive improvement! A 45% latency reduction will definitely impress Boss Zhang and prove the refactoring is worth it. Anything else to wrap up?
Not much. I asked if Wanghao wanted to grab lunch after prepping for the OKR review, but he just wanted to rest. Can you just log that latency metric for me?
You got it. I'll note down Wanghao's 45% latency reduction projection. Go grab some lunch and take a break yourself!

Man, I am just so done with today. That OKR review was brutal. Boss Zhang wants the refactoring done by end of Q3, and Wanghao is pushing his 45% latency reduction engine. I'm feeling extremely overwhelmed after the OKR review because of these aggressive deadlines they just dumped on me.
That sounds incredibly stressful, Linchen. End of Q3 is a super tight turnaround for a full classroom refactoring, especially with a new rendering engine in the mix. How are you holding up?

Barely hanging in there. The meeting itself was a nightmare. The OKR review slide deck was 50 pages long! To make it worse, we had to sit there while the projector flickered during the OKR review the entire time.
A flickering projector for 50 slides? That's literal torture. No wonder you're feeling so overwhelmed. Did anyone else feel the same way?
Oh yeah, Sister Chen was completely exhausted too. After we got out, Sister Chen suggested we get boba tea to recover from the OKR review.
Boba tea sounds like a solid survival strategy right now. Did the sugar rush help take the edge off?
A little bit, yeah. It was definitely better than what they gave us in the meeting room. Sister Chen said the snacks provided at the OKR review were completely stale.
Stale snacks and aggressive deadlines—what a terrible combo. Take it easy tonight, Linchen. We can tackle breaking down those Q3 deadlines tomorrow.

input_messages.content: Hey, I need to block out my calendar for this weekend. I just made a serious promise to Liwei that I will dedicate this entire weekend exclusively to the apartment hunting. No work, no coding, just finding us a place.

Done, I've blocked out your weekend calendar. Honestly, it's probably good to step away from the classroom refactoring for a couple of days, especially since you were feeling so overwhelmed by the Q3 deadline yesterday.

Yeah, I really need the break. Plus, Liwei mentioned a coworker of hers who also just started the apartment hunting, so she's worried the good places will get snatched up. It was funny though, right in the middle of our serious talk about it, Liwei saw a super cute dog and got totally distracted.
Haha, that sounds exactly like her! Do you guys have a game plan for getting around to all the viewings?

We haven't finalized that yet. We actually debated whether to take the subway or a taxi for the apartment hunting. Subway is predictable, but a taxi is way less tiring. I'm also wondering if it would rain during the apartment hunting, which would make the subway a pain.

Yes, please set one for 8 AM. I really want to keep my commitment to Liwei and make sure we find a great spot.
You got it. Alarm is set for 8 AM on Saturday. Have a great time apartment hunting with Liwei!
Hey, I just got off a call with my Mom to update her on my living situation. Classic Mom, she asked if I had eaten dinner before we even started talking about the apartment hunting.
Classic mom move indeed! Did you manage to give her a good update on the search after the dinner check-in?

Yeah, though it was a bit chaotic. I had to warn her my phone battery was low while we were discussing the apartment hunting. Plus, she was complaining about her neighbor's loud music during the call.
Sounds like a distracting environment! Did you guys actually get any planning done before your phone died?
We got sidetracked again and briefly talked about a TV show we both watch, but we eventually returned to the topic of the apartment hunting. I had to reassure her about the finances.
That makes sense, rent prices can be stressful. What did you agree on for the financials?
I promised Mom I would not exceed a monthly budget of 8000 RMB during the apartment hunting. Since I'm dedicating this whole weekend to the search, I need to stick to that hard limit.
That's a very clear and reasonable boundary to set. 8000 RMB gives you a solid target for this weekend's search. Want me to start pulling some listings in that range near the office?
